passive.name: Rebirth
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Break Effect by **60/70/80/90/100%**. When an enemy target's Weakness gets broken, there is a **100%** base chance to inflict the "Charring" state on it, which increases its Break DMG taken by **18/21/24/27/30%**, lasting for **2** turn(s). This effect can stack **2** time(s).

passive.name: Deceit
passive.text: Increases the wearer's SPD by **18/21/24/27/30%**. After the wearer uses an attack, there is a **120%** base chance to inflict the "Bamboozle" state on every enemy target. While under the "Bamboozle" state, enemy targets have their DEF decreased by **16/18/20/22/24%** for **2** turn(s). If the wearer's SPD is higher than or equal to **170**, there is a **120%** base chance to inflict the "Theft" state on every enemy target. While under the "Theft" state, enemy targets have their DEF decreased by **8/9/10/11/12%** for **2** turn(s). When "Bamboozle" or "Theft" is repeatedly inflicted, only the most recently inflicted instance takes effect.

weapons.name: Resolution Shines As Pearls of Sweat

passive.name: Glance Back
passive.text: When the wearer hits an enemy and if the hit enemy is not already "Ensnared," then there is a **60/70/80/90/100%** base chance to "Ensnare" the hit enemy. "Ensnared" enemies' DEF decreases by **12/13/14/15/16%** for **1** turn(s).

passive.name: Chaos Elixir
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Break Effect by **20/25/30/35/40%**. When the wearer uses their Ultimate, increases DoT dealt by the wearer by **24/30/36/42/48%**, lasting for **2** turn(s). When a target enemy suffering from DoT imposed by the wearer is defeated, regenerates **4/4.5/5/5.5/6** Energy for the wearer.

passive.name: Quick on the Draw
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Effect Hit Rate by **20/25/30/35/40%**. When the wearer attacks DEF-reduced enemies, regenerates **4/5/6/7/8** Energy.

substatLine: Effect Hit Rate (Until 67%) > Break Effect > SPD > HP% = DEF%
tracePriority: Sylvan Enigma (A4) > Phecda Primordia (A6) > Verdantia Renaissance (A2)

entries.name: Radiant Streak
entries.text: Deals Fire DMG equal to **100%** of Fugue's ATK to one designated enemy.

entries.name: Fiery Caress
entries.text: Deals Fire DMG equal to **100%** of Fugue's ATK to one designated enemy and Fire DMG equal to **50%** of Fugue's ATK to adjacent targets.

entries.name: Virtue Beckons Bliss
entries.text:
Grants one designated ally "Foxian Prayer". Enters the "Torrid Scorch" state, lasting for **3** turn(s). The duration decreases by 1 at the start of Fugue's every turn. "Foxian Prayer" only takes effect on the most recent target of Fugue's Skill.
The ally target with "Foxian Prayer" increases their Break Effect by **30%** and can also reduce Toughness even when attacking enemies that don't have the corresponding Weakness Type, with the effect equivalent to **50%** of the original Toughness Reduction value. This cannot stack with other Toughness Reduction effects that also ignore Weakness Type.
While in the "Torrid Scorch" state, Fugue enhances her Basic ATK. Every time an ally target with "Foxian Prayer" attacks, Fugue has a **100%** base chance to reduce the attacked enemy target's DEF by **18%**, lasting for **2** turn(s).

entries.name: Solar Splendor Shines Upon All
entries.text: Deals Fire DMG equal to **200%** of Fugue's ATK to all enemies. This attack ignores Weakness Type to reduce all enemies' Toughness. And when breaking Weakness, triggers the Fire Weakness Break effect.

entries.name: Fortune Follows Where Virtue Spreads
entries.text:
While Fugue is on the field, enemy targets will get additionally afflicted with "Cloudflame Luster," equal to **40%** of their Max Toughness. When the initial Toughness is reduced to 0, "Cloudflame Luster" can continue to be reduced. When "Cloudflame Luster" is reduced to 0, the enemy will receive Weakness Break DMG again.
While Fugue is on the field and after allies attack Weakness Broken enemy targets, converts the Toughness Reduction of this attack into 1 instance of **100%** Super Break DMG.

entries.name: Percipient Shine
entries.text:
After using Technique, inflicts Daze on enemies within a certain area, lasting for **10** second(s). While Dazed, enemies will not actively attack ally targets.
After entering battle via actively attacking Dazed enemies, Fugue's action advances by **40%**, with a **100%** base chance to inflict each enemy target with the same DEF Reduction state as that applied by Fugue's Skill, lasting for **2** turn(s).

entries.name: Verdantia Renaissance
entries.text: After ally targets break weakness, additionally delays the action of the enemy target by **15%**.

entries.name: Sylvan Enigma
entries.text: Increases this unit's Break Effect by **30%**. After using Skill for the first time, immediately recovers **1** Skill Point(s).

entries.name: Phecda Primordia
entries.text: When an enemy target's Weakness gets broken, increases teammates' (i.e., excluding this unit) Break Effect by **6%**. If Fugue's Break Effect is **220%** or higher, the Break Effect increase is boosted by an additional **12%**, lasting for **2** turn(s). This effect can stack up to **2** time(s).

entries.name: Earthbound I Was, Cloudward I Be
entries.text: Ally target with "Foxian Prayer" increases their Weakness Break Efficiency by 50%.

entries.name: Beatitude Dawns for the Worthy
entries.text: When an enemy target's Weakness gets broken, Fugue regenerates 3 Energy. After using Ultimate, advances the action of all allies by 24%.

entries.name: Verity Weaves Thoughts to Blade
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Bereft of Form, Which Name to Bear
entries.text: Ally target with "Foxian Prayer" increases their Break DMG dealt by 20%.

entries.name: Colored Cloud Rains Fortune
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Clairvoyance of Boom and Doom
entries.text: Increases Fugue's Weakness Break Efficiency by 50%. While Fugue is in the "Torrid Scorch" state, "Foxian Prayer" takes effect on all allies.
